slug: 2025-02-05 Cameroon's new-generation biometric national ID card system (Augentic) goes live

systems.system: new-generation biometric national ID card (CNI) system
systems.country_label: biometric and digital national ID card (CNI)
systems.owner: General Delegation for National Security (DGSN), under a 15-year build-operate-transfer contract signed May 2024 with Augentic
systems.tiers: online pre-enrolment from 17 February 2025; biometric capture from 24 February at regional-capital identification posts; issuance from early March 2025, first at two Yaounde centres

note: On the launch of the national identity card system; nothing on civil registration.
